description: Foundation: scaffold the Next.js app in the repo root, pin the known-good stack, define shared types, build the committed data generator + receivers.json, centralize TOE/expectation/story logic, and build the data-loading + filtering context. Everything the UI features depend on. Independent of FEAT-002/003/004 which all consume this foundation.
steps: Scaffold Next.js directly into c:\Users\yousu\OneDrive\Documents\GitHub\visualisation (the app root IS this folder). Use create-next-app with TypeScript, App Router, Tailwind, ESLint, src dir, import alias @/*. Keep the existing plan.md for now (README replaces it in FEAT-004). If create-next-app refuses a non-empty dir, scaffold in a temp dir and move files in, or hand-create config — the end state is a working Next.js 15 App Router + Tailwind 3 + TS project.
In package.json pin react@^18, react-dom@^18, next@^15. Install recharts@^2, @nivo/sankey and @nivo/core. Add npm script "generate-data": "node scripts/generate-data.mjs". Run `npm install`.

Create src/lib/types.ts with: ExpectationModel { formula:string; a:number; b:number }, ReceiverWeekRow (all columns from context.json data_model.row_shape with exact names and 0-1/number types), ReceiversFile { schemaVersion:string; generatedAt:string; expectationModel:ExpectationModel; receivers:ReceiverWeekRow[] }, and enums/union types Position='WR'|'TE'|'RB', CoverageFilter='all'|'man'|'zone', PositionFilter=Position|'all'.

Create scripts/generate-data.mjs: documented generator producing 80-100 distinct receivers across all 32 real team abbreviations (list in context.json), each with 8 weekly rows (weeks 1-8), believable archetypes (alpha WR, slot, deep threat, checkdown RB, ignored role player). Enforce consistency: receptions<=targets<=routesRun; openRateVsMan/openRateVsZone average ~ openRate and targetShareVsMan/targetShareVsZone average ~ targetShare; each team's weekly targetShare across its receivers sums to ~1; set expectedTargetShare = clamp(a + b*openRate,0,1) and toe = targetShare - expectedTargetShare using a,b written into expectationModel. Assign gameId/opponent per week. Write the result to public/data/receivers.json. Document the expectation formula and all assumptions in header comments.
Run `node scripts/generate-data.mjs` to produce and COMMIT public/data/receivers.json.

Create scripts/check-data.mjs: load public/data/receivers.json and assert 32 teams present, 80-100 distinct players, every row toe == targetShare-expectedTargetShare within 1e-9, receptions<=targets<=routesRun for every row, all positions in {WR,TE,RB}. Exit non-zero on any failure.

Create src/lib/toe.ts: expectedTargetShare(openRate, model=defaultModel), toe(row), a defaultModel mirroring expectationModel a/b, teamConcentration(rows) returning a Gini-like 0-1 spread score + a one-receiver-offense boolean, and coverageSpecialist(row) classifying 'man-only'|'zone-only'|'wins-both'|'neither'. Create src/lib/stories.ts: deriveStoryHook(row) returning a one-line narrative string (e.g. 'Only targeted 18% despite 52% open rate vs man'), and selectTopNarratives(rows) returning the 3-5 most interesting stories for Story Mode (biggest over-target, biggest ignored, a one-receiver offense, a man/zone specialist, a checkdown pattern).

Create scripts/check-logic.mjs: assert deriveStoryHook and classifiers return sane values on a few hand-built sample rows (positive-toe over-target, negative-toe ignored, man-only specialist). Exit non-zero on failure.

Create src/lib/filters.ts (applyFilters(rows, {week, position, coverage, gameId})), src/context/DashboardProvider.tsx (client component: fetch('/data/receivers.json'), validate shape against ReceiversFile, hold filter state + storyMode flag, expose raw rows and a useMemo'd filtered dataset; handle loading and empty-filter states), and src/hooks/useDashboard.ts (useContext wrapper that throws if used outside provider).
acceptance_criteria: `npm install` completes with no errors and package.json shows react@18.x, next@15.x, recharts@2.x, @nivo/sankey present.
`npm run build` exits 0 with no type or build errors.
public/data/receivers.json exists, is committed, and `node scripts/check-data.mjs` exits 0 (32 teams, 80-100 players, toe/consistency rules hold).
src/lib/types.ts, src/lib/toe.ts, src/lib/stories.ts, src/lib/filters.ts, src/context/DashboardProvider.tsx, src/hooks/useDashboard.ts all exist and compile.
findings:
COMPLETED via Option A (real data is source of truth; see note below).

=== STACK (npm install OK) ===
react 18.3.1, react-dom 18.3.1, next 15.5.27, recharts 2.15.4, @nivo/core 0.99.0, @nivo/sankey 0.99.0, tailwindcss 3.4.19, typescript 5.9.3. App Router under app/, source under src/ with @/* -> ./src/*. Scaffolded by hand (dir was non-empty: had .agents/, plan.md) — all config present: package.json, tsconfig.json, next.config.mjs, postcss.config.mjs, tailwind.config.ts, .eslintrc.json, next-env.d.ts, .gitignore.

=== DATA (THE KEY DEVIATION) ===
public/data/receivers.json is REAL data, NOT my synthetic generator's output. schemaVersion '1.0.0-real', 2537 rows, 468 distinct players, 32 teams, weeks 1-8, positions WR/TE/RB. Built by scripts/build-real-data.mjs (another step; from sibling ucl-nfl-aws PFF/play CSVs). A byte-identical backup exists at public/data/receivers.real.json. Field names/types EXACTLY match src/lib/types.ts ReceiverWeekRow (verified). gameId in real data is the game key e.g. '2021091207' (NOT week-prefixed) but is unique per game; use filters.ts availableGames(rows, week) to scope.

EXPECTATION MODEL: real per-row expectedTargetShare is a route-participation baseline (routesRun/teamRoutes(week)) and is STORED ON EACH ROW along with toe = targetShare - expectedTargetShare. LATER FEATS MUST read row.expectedTargetShare and row.toe FROM THE ROW. Do NOT recompute per-row expectation from a+b*openRate. The fitted linear coefficients expectationModel.a=0.085037, b=0.067407 (mirrored in src/lib/toe.ts defaultModel) are ONLY for drawing the headline scatter's diagonal reference line via toe.ts expectedTargetShareLine(openRate) and as a fallback.

SYNTHETIC FALLBACK: scripts/generate-data.mjs now writes public/data/receivers.sample.json (88 players, 704 rows) — it NEVER overwrites receivers.json. `npm run generate-data` is wired to it.

=== FILE PATHS LATER FEATS CONSUME ===
- src/lib/types.ts: Position('WR'|'TE'|'RB'), CoverageFilter('all'|'man'|'zone'), PositionFilter(Position|'all'), ReceiverWeekRow, ReceiversFile, ExpectationModel.
- src/lib/toe.ts: expectedTargetShareLine(openRate, model?) [reference line only], toe(row) [reads row], teamConcentration(rows) -> {gini, oneReceiverOffense, topShare}, coverageSpecialist(row, threshold=0.5) -> 'man-only'|'zone-only'|'wins-both'|'neither', defaultModel {a:0.085037,b:0.067407}. NOTE: the old name expectedTargetShare() was RENAMED to expectedTargetShareLine() to prevent misuse.
- src/lib/stories.ts: deriveStoryHook(row) -> string; selectTopNarratives(rows) -> Narrative[] (<=5; kinds: over-targeted, ignored, one-receiver-offense, coverage-specialist, checkdown). Narrative = {kind,title,hook,playerName,team,score}.
- src/lib/filters.ts: FilterState {week:number|'all', position:PositionFilter, coverage:CoverageFilter, gameId:string|'all'}, defaultFilters, applyFilters(rows,filters) [week/position/gameId narrow rows; coverage does NOT drop rows — it selects which man/zone split a section reads], availableWeeks(rows), availableGames(rows, week?).
- src/context/DashboardProvider.tsx (client): fetch('/data/receivers.json', no-store) + runtime shape validation; exposes {loading,error,rows,filtered,model,filters,setFilters(partial),resetFilters,storyMode,setStoryMode,toggleStoryMode}. filtered is useMemo(applyFilters).
- src/hooks/useDashboard.ts: useDashboard() throws outside provider.
- app/page.tsx wraps app/DashboardShell.tsx ('use client') in <DashboardProvider>. DashboardShell is a FOUNDATION PLACEHOLDER showing load/row counts — FEAT-002/003/004 replace its body with FilterBar + the 5 sections, each calling useDashboard().
- app/layout.tsx, app/globals.css (Tailwind + dark broadcast palette: ink/panel/edge/pos(cyan)/neg(rose)/accent(yellow) in tailwind.config.ts).

=== VERIFICATION (all pass) ===
npm install OK; node scripts/check-data.mjs OK (now validates schema+consistency+32 teams+weeks 1-8+50..1200 players+toe within 5e-4, NOT a synthetic count); node scripts/check-logic.mjs OK; npm run build exits 0, no type/build errors (route / = 104kB first load). Lockfile-root warning: left default (removed the outputFileTracingRoot experiment); build is clean. Dev-server smoke check was BLOCKED by the sandbox's long-running-command guard (could not run `npm run dev`), so runtime render was not exercised; production build static-generates app/ fine and the data file is served from public/. NOTE: on OneDrive, running `npm run build` twice back-to-back can throw a spurious readlink EINVAL on .next — delete .next and rebuild; it is not a code error.
